1. Krishna Kumar
2. Dipankar Saha @ Dipankar Kumar Saha .... .... .... Petitioners Versus The State of Jharkhand ....

For the Petitioners : Mrs. Nitu Sinha, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, Addl.P.P ------
Order No.10 Dated- 22.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Radhanagar P.S. Case No. 90 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. No. 367 of 2020 (POCSO Case No.19 of 2022) instituted under Sections 366-A, 376, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4/6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(i)(S) Of SC/ST Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per FIR, allegation is that petitioners in furtherance of their common intention along with other co-accused persons have got the informant's minor daughter boarded in a tempo and kidnapped her.
Thereafter, co-accused Diwakar Shrma committed rape with the minor victim girl aged about 15 years.

Learned counsel for the petitioner has pleaded the innocence of petitioners and submitted that the minor victim, in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. has stated nothing against the petitioners.
No specific overt act has been attributed against the petitioners and they are simple villagers having no criminal antecedent.
Petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case with ulterior motive and they undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners and submits that there is direct allegation against the petitioner of kidnapping the minor victim girl to get her solemnized marriage with co-accused person without her will and she was also ravished Krishna Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143850138/
1 by them.

sentences.text: Hence, petitioners may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances as stated above, coupled with materials available on record against the petitioners showing their involvement in a serious offence, I am not inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioners is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
